purpose: Eighth-pass official and first-party verification for five existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction notices, first-party operator pages, Companies House records, Food Standards Agency records and local-authority routes are promoted. Current trading or a registered office does not prove title, lease completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.historical_status_policy: Sold, Sold Post, Withdrawn Post and vacant-possession statements remain historical unless independently reconfirmed.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

The two current exact-unit operator routes therefore cover both numbered retail units, but do not prove legal completion, current flat tenancies or the freehold boundary.
